newsitem.title: UK: ST PAUL INTERNATIONAL AWARDED ISO 9001.
newsitem.headline: ST PAUL INTERNATIONAL AWARDED ISO 9001.

text.p: The UK commercial insurance arm of St Paul International has achieved the ISO 9001 quality certification.
"ISO 9001 provides a model for quality assurance in product design, development, implementation and servicing", said Les walker, quality manager at St Paul International.
The ISO 9000 standards were published in 1987 by the International Organisation for Standardisation in Switzerland and have since been adopted by more than 100 countries.

The award made to St Paul International covers the design of commercial insurance products for identified industry sectors, the issue of quotations, preparation of policy documents, claims management, risk management and the appointment of agents.

St Paul International Insurance Company is part of The St Paul Companies Inc. The UK commercial insurance department markets property and liability insurance products aimed at NHS trusts, private hospitals and medical service companies.
